title: Chapter 579
paragraphs: Chapter 579
Episode 150: When It's Time to Receive the Reward (2)
What Danté commissioned 'No-name' to do was to assassinate the emperor and bring his head.
Although he wanted to demand a live capture if possible, Owl assigned Yona as the assassin to kill the emperor.
There was no assassin who could find and kill the emperor faster than her, and Owl was worried that the royal family might secure the emperor's new recruits before 'No-name's' blade could reach him.
This was the reason why Owl refused the live capture request. Yona had assassination skills that exceeded even her own, but she was uncontrollable.

Even when she saw the emperor herself, there was no way she would leave him alive. Because the emperor attacking Hiran not only threatened the empire, but also her younger brother Jin, who Yona cherishes more than anything in the world.
Regrettably, Danté had to accept that condition for the same reason as Owl.
No matter how great the resentment, Danté was not the type of person who would capture the emperor and torture him.
Therefore, he had to secure the emperor's neck in the most certain and fast way, and hang it in the square to inform the empire that they had escaped his rule.
But, contrary to everyone's expectations,
Yona brought the emperor alive with a bright smile on her face. To Hiran's second city in the imperial capital, where Jin and Danté were waiting.
"Heh, Little one. You have no idea how much I wanted to kill this skinny piece of meat?"
The most surprised was Owl. Seeing Yona dragging the unconscious emperor like a piece of luggage, Owl was about to drop the cigarette he was biting.
"Oh, Yona... how did you think to bring him alive?"
"I thought the little one would want to handle this more than me, hehe. I did well, didn't I?"
As Yona casually threw the emperor in front of them and spoke, Owl narrowed his eyebrows as if worried.
"Are you, are you okay?"
Since the chaos of Gliac engulfed Inse.
Lately, Yona's control over her chaos was starting to torment her again.
This was because her chaos was responding to the chaos of Gliac, which could be said to be the source of that dark power.
Owl knew this fact, and he was here to discuss it with Jin.
"I'm fine for now, heh. To the extent that I won't kill anyone I see? And if the little one likes it, I can bear it a little!"
Yona's face, who said she was fine, was pale. Suppressing the urge to kill, which was forcibly amplified by the chaos, was never easy.
Although she was born a murderer, immersed in chaos since birth, her nature was composed of a kind and pure energy that was not typical of the Runcandels.

Jin first recognized Yona's inner state during his days as a prospective jockey, and thanks to that, she was able to control the chaos, and was still holding on even though she had become unstable again.
“From now on, don't take on any live capture missions.”
“Thank you, brother. But I hope you will always prioritize your condition from now on.”
“My little one is worried about me.”
“Of course.”
"Hehe, good, good. Then, I need to rest for a bit. I'll be fine by tomorrow evening, so you just wait, little one. Let's play!"
"Of course."
As Yona went out the window and disappeared somewhere, Owl touched his forehead. Jin's expression also darkened. It was because of the words they had been discussing before Yona came.
“Sir Owl, was it really that bad?”

“Yes. At the point when that guy Gliac woke up, she had a seizure and went on a rampage. Luckily, all the top assassins, including myself, were nearby, so there were no fatalities, but if we hadn't been... I don't even want to imagine.”
Jin looked at the wounds on Owl's face and hands. They were wounds caused by subduing the rampaging Yona.
‘Even with the top 10 assassins present, Sir Owl was injured. That's what it means.’
He had never thought that Gliac's awakening would lead to Yona's rampage.
‘At the time, both Sir Amella and the Prochi siblings were having seizures because of Gliac's energy. But my sister went on a rampage even though she was so far away from the battlefield.’

There is still not much known about the chaos in the world. Jin, who directly experienced Gliac, only knows that the kings of chaos were born due to the mistake of the gods known as the Origin Stones, and that without the power of creation, they could never stand against them.
But he was able to infer the connection of the situation.
“Gliac's remnants left in the world are not causing the same reaction in all chaos infectees as they do in Sister Yona.”
The seizures of Amella and the Prochi siblings subsided not long after the Barmel Alliance escaped the battlefield with the help of Runcandel.
Now, with only the remnants of the guy left, it's no different from before the incident.
“Is this happening only to those infected with a certain amount of chaos?”
“I think so. Have you ever seen the chaos that Sister Yona has?”
“I have.”
“Sir Amella is also a chaos infectee. Sister Yona knew this and came to suppress Sir Amella's chaos, but the difference between Sister Yona's chaos and Sir Amella's chaos was too great to compare.”
Then Jin pointed to the documents on the table.

“And these documents contain cases of demonic transformation and rampage other than Sister Yona. These are things found out by the information brokers and reporters of the Barmel Alliance, similar things are happening all over the world.”

Among the rampagers, none showed as much formidable force as Yona. Of course, they were at a level that could be suppressed only with knights and wizards of at least 7 or 8 stars, but they were nothing compared to Yona.
If the reaction to Gliac's energy is indeed determined by the size of the chaos, then Yona's chaos is on a different level from them.
“Phew.”
Owl let out a sigh as if frustrated.
As of now, there's no way to prevent the rampaging of those infected with chaos.
And Owl, who regarded Yona as more than his successor, truly cared for her.
Jin was also frustrated.
“I'll keep looking for a way too.”
“I'll make sure to share any related information from the Anonymous with the Barmel Alliance as it comes out.”

Owl was now treating Jin not merely as a jockey of Runcandel, but as the commander-in-chief of the Barmel Alliance. It was not only because he personally highly evaluated Jin, and had gratitude towards Yona.
With the Sword Emperor Hall, the world's landscape had changed, so perhaps Anonymous might not have much time left to maintain neutrality.
“Anyway, I need to go watch over Yona. With this, the request is complete. Jin, and Dante Hyran.”
Dante had been staring at the emperor lying on the ground while the two were conversing.
“Yes, Sir Owl. The additional reward for the capture will be paid as you inform….”
At Dante's words, Owl shook his head.
“There's no need for that. After all, didn't our Anonymous also owe Ron? Besides, I had a debt to Ron in my youth.”
Owl took out a single chrysanthemum from his pocket.
“Since I can't offer it to Ron's light, who is now in the Sword Emperor Hall, please offer it to him on my behalf when a temporary monument is erected within the empire.”
As Owl stepped forward, Jin and Dante looked down at the emperor. The torn clothes, shabby appearance, and emaciated body showed what kind of fugitive life he had led.
“He seems to have received no protection from the royal family.”
At Jin's words, Dante nodded.
The two of them were not unaware of the fact that the reason the royal family did not protect the emperor was not only due to 'public sentiment'.
It meant that the emperor no longer possessed the royal family's most important cards, including the 'Mine transformation'.
“I need to announce my reign to the people at noon.”
Slap, slap!
Dante woke him up by slapping the emperor's cheek.
"Ugh, ergh!"
"Criminal of civil unrest, Amir Biment."
"Dante... Hyran?"
"Two hours from now, you will stand in the palace square, where you incited Hyran to be a traitor. Your fate will be determined there."
The Emperor did not seem too shocked, as if he had already given up. He knew the royal family had abandoned him.
Moreover, even Zipho broke his promise with him during the first battle, so he had no foundation left.
"Hehe... Are you planning to publicly execute me and declare the era of Hyran? Are you going to cut my throat with that sword?"
“No, killing you is not Hyran's revenge…”
With a swoosh, Dante opened the central window, pulling back the curtain, and the crowd gathering like clouds in the distance came into view.
The people were shouting. They demanded that Amir Biment, who should be torn and killed immediately, be brought out.
They were ready to start a riot right away.
"It's the sentiment of the empire."
The calm eyes of the Emperor suddenly darkened and quivered.
What Amir Biment feared was not death or torture. It was not being abandoned by the royal family, nor losing the position of Emperor.
It was the resentful voices of the people. He was unaware of it himself.
Amir Biment was a cruel and grotesque figure, but his love for his people as an emperor was sincere.

- After all, they have neither the power nor the will to stop me. Even though they like Hyran more than me, they don't sincerely risk their lives. I find such naive and annoying behavior of the people cute and lovely.
Words he had spoken to Alton Hyran in the palace square just before the Sword Emperor Hall.
Unlike then, the people now were showing a determination to kill the Emperor, even if it meant death.
This was breaking down the Emperor's inner self, made up of arrogance, autocracy, and pride. He was not yet ready to say goodbye to his people.
A pitiful man, who spent his life in unrequited love, was now about to meet death at their hands.
Amir Biment was more pained by the fact that he had only just realized this than by being dethroned and facing death.
Two hours later.
The Emperor, thrown into the square, was stoned by the people until nothing of his figure remained.
The people did not leave, continuing to curse even after all that was left on the ground where he had stood were stains made of blood, flesh, and bone.
